tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example}[Closed surfaces are $K(G,1)$'s] ↗ thm:graph-of-groups-is-kg1 ↗ ex:graphs-are-kg1 1. ch1:1B.14\group Fundamental Group

Closed orientable surfaces of genus at least $2$ are graphs-of-groups spaces with injective edge maps, hence are $K(G,1)$ spaces with universal cover $\R ^2$. The same holds for closed nonorientable surfaces other than $\RP ^2$; nonclosed surfaces retract to graphs. \end{example}

The correspondence between graphs of groups and group actions on trees is developed further in \cite{ScottWall1979}.
